role: Scoring constants extracted from RecoveryScoreCalculator and the readiness/training model: HRV adjustment deltas, baseline staleness penalty, absolute-RMSSD fallback bands, readiness capacity model, label thresholds, monotony, vitals overrides and legacy display thresholds. Hashed by scripts/check_scoring_governance.sh.
types: RecoveryScoreConstants: enum — namespaces HRVAdjustments, BaselineStaleness, AbsoluteRMSSDFallback, SleepDetail, Readiness, ReadinessLabels, Training, Vitals, DisplayThresholds plus missingSleepPenalty
toplevel: Only static let constants; no units.

flags.text: Unreferenced anywhere in Swift: Readiness.acwrDetrainingThreshold/acwrDetrainingPenaltySlope/acwrDetrainingPenaltyCap, ReadinessLabels.acwrElevated/acwrAboveAverage, Training.severeMonotonyModifier/moderateMonotonyModifier/mildMonotonyModifier, plus Vitals respiratory/temperature values and all of DisplayThresholds (the last two are documented as kept only for the governance hash). The ACWR-detraining and monotony-modifier ones carry no such note: the detraining penalty and monotony modifiers their doc comments describe are read by no code.
